content: Bosha Hayqoy Wodhontta Yeggi Aadheth
Gibxe biittan GODAY Musenne Aaroone hizgides;
«Ha aginay inttes layththas koyro agina gido;
Isra7eele asaa ubbaas hayssa ha wogaza yootite; hayssi aginay gelida tammanththa gallas, issi issi asi ba soo asas issi laaqqa doori ekko.
He keeththa asaa qooday laaqqaza ubbaa maanaas guuxxizaa gidikko izaadey baas matattiza guta ba soo asaa mala qoodidi issaadey issaadey mi wursanayssa shaakki eretto.
Intte doori ekkana laaqqay yelettiin issi layth gididi iza bolla aykko borey baynda adde laaqqa gido. Intte laaqqaza dorsafe woykko deyshafe ekkanaas dandayeeta.
Ha aginay tammanne oydanththo gallas gidana gakkanaas istta naagite; he gallas arshey wullishin Isra7eele maabara asay wuri istta shukkanaas koshshees.
Shukkidi suuththafe ekkidi istta ashoza miza keeththas qosilaththaanne qoreza bolla tiyetto.
Ashoza he gallas qammaka taman xiixidi, cammiza bonccoranne irshoy baynda uukettida ukeththara metto.
Ashoza qaye woykko doyssidi moopite; hu7eza; gedata; qanththa ashozakka ubbaa xiixidi miite.
He ashozappe gadey wonttana gakkanaas aykkoka ashshofte. Wonttana gakkanaas attidaazi diikko taman xuuggana koshshees.
Miish, oges gidiza may7o may7idi, intte caamma tohon aaththidi intte guufe intte kushen oykkidi eeson miite; hayssi tana GODAA intte bonchchiza Paaziga yarsho.
«Tani he gallas qammara Gibxe biittara hemettashe bayra yelettida, asekka mehekka ubbaa wodhana. Gibxe eeqata ubbaa bollaka tani pirdana; tani GODAA gidikkinaa?
He suuththay intte diza keeththata erisiza malata gidana. Tani he suuththaa be7iza wode inttena agga aadhdhana; tani Gibxe biittaa boshan shociza wode intte bolla aykko boshaykka gakkenna.
«He gallassay tani GODAY inttes ooththidayssa qoppi qoppi bonchchiza gallas gido; intte zereththi wuri GODAA ba7aale bonchcho; hayssa inttes woga histtidi mernaas bonchchite.
Ukeththa Ba7aale

«Laappun gallas gakkanaas irshoy gelontta uketh miite; koyro gallas intte sooppe irsho diggite. He koyro gallassafe doommidi laappunththa gallas gakkanaas, irshora diza uketh miza asi oonikka Isra7eele asaa giddofe shaaketti dhayo.

Koyro gallas geeshsha duulata shiiqite; hara geeshsha duulata qasse laappunththa gallas shiiqite; asay wuri maanaas quma kaththofe attiin he gallassata ubbaan aykkoka ooththofte; intte ooththana miishshi hessa xalla.
«Tani inttena Isra7eele nayta Gibxe biittafe kessiday he gallas gidida gishshas Ukeththa ba7aale bonchchite. He gallassa ba7aaleza naa naas attontta woga histti bonchchite.
Koyro aginan he aginaas tammanne oydanththa gallassa omarsafe doommidi nam7u tammanne issinththa gallassa omarsa gakkanaas irshoy gelontta uketh miite.
Laappun gallas gakkanaas irshoy intte soon beettofo; irshoy gelida kath miza asi bete asi gidiin woykko he dere as oonakka gidiin hessaadey Isra7eele maabara giddofe dhayo.
Irshoy gelidaaz aykkoka moopite; intte dizason awanka irshoy gelontta uketh maanaas bessees.»
Hessafe guye Musey Isra7eele cimata ubbaa xeygisidi, «Intte biidi intte soo asaas Paaziga yarshos laaqqa ekki shukkite.

Hisophphe geetettiza maata hayththafe danki ekkidi keren diza suuththaan gelththi kessidi, he suuththaa nam7u qosilaththataninne qoreta bolla tiyite; inttefe issi asikka gadey wonttana gakkanaas ba keeththafe kare kezoppo.

GODAY Gibxe bayra nayta wodhanaas he biittara hemettiza wode suuth keeththa qosilaththataninne qoreta bolla be7idi karera aadhdhi baana; wodhizayssi intte soo gelidi inttena wodhontta mala iza GODAY diggana.
«Intte hayssa azazoza inttessinne intte zereththas mernaas woga histtidi azazettite.
GODAY kase immana giidi caaqqida qaala mala izi immiza biittaa intte geliza wode ha wogaa naagite.
Intte nayti inttena, ‹Hayssa ha wogazas birsheththi aazee?› gi oychchiko,

intte isttas, ‹Hayssi GODAA bonchchanaas yarshiza Paaziga yarsho; ays giikko GODAY Gibxe biittan Isra7eele asaa keeth aggi aadhdhidi Gibxe asaa wodhidi nuna ashshida gishshassa› giite» gides. Hessafe guye asay biitta bolla gufanni goynnides.
Isra7eele asay biidi GODAY Musenne Aaroone azazida mala ooththides.
Gibxe Asaa Bayrati Hayqqi Wuro

Giddi giddoththan GODAY Gibxen bayra yelettida ubbaa kawoteththa algan uttiza kawo bayra naappe doommidi, qasho keeththan diza di7ettida asaa bayra naa gakkanaas, qasse bayra yelettida mehe ubbaa dippi histtides.
Kawoy, izi sunththida daannatinne Gibxe biitta asay wuri qammara beeggides. Gibxe biittan asi hayqqontta keeththi mulekka baynda gishshas asay qaala dhoqqu histtidi daro waassi yeekkides.
He gallassa omars kawozi Musenne Aaroone xeygisidi, «Dendite! Intteka intte asaykka ta asaa giddofe kezite! Biidi intte oychchida malakka GODAAS goynnite!
Intte gida malakka intte mehe; intte deyshinne dors ubbaa ekkidi biite! Qasse tanakka anjjite» gides.
Isra7eele asay ba biittafe eeson kezana mala Gibxe asay dirbasides. Ays giikko istti, «Kezontta ixxiko nuni wurikka wurana» gida.
Hessa gishshas Isra7eele asay irshoy gelontta munuqa keren kunththi may7on xaaxidi hashen tookkides.
Isra7eele asay Musey istta azazida mala, Gibxe asaa bira, worqqanne may7o, «Immite» gi oychchides.
GODAY Gibxe asaa sinththan Isra7eele asay sabettana mala ooththida gishshas Gibxe asay istta oychchidayssa ubbaa immida. Hessaththo histtidi istta Gibxe asata aqo buuri ekki bida.
Gibxeppe Isra7eele Asaa Kes
Isra7eele asay Eraamise geetettiza katamappe dendidi Sukoote geetettizaso gakkanaas bides. Asay naytanne maccassaa gujjontta qoodiin tohon hemettiza attuma asay 600,000 gidides.
Qasse isttara daro hara dere asay, keehi daro mehe, dorsinne deysh ekki kezides.
Gibxeppe istti ekki kezida irshoy gelontta munuqappe uketh uukkida; ays giikko istta Gibxeppe eeson kessida gishshas baas shinqe kaththanaassinne munuqay dendiin uukkana wode istta gaththibeenna.
Isra7eele asay Gibxe biittan deyida layththay wuri oyddu xeetanne heedzdzu tamma.
He oyddu xeetanne heedzdzu tammu layththay wuriza he wurseththa gallassan GODAA asay wuri Gibxe biittafe kezides.
Gibxe biittafe omarsa wode GODAY ba asaa kessishe naagida gishshas he qammay naa naa gakkanaas, Isra7eele asay wuri beeggi naagidi aqiza GODAAS dummatida qamma.
Paaziga Bonchchiza Woga
GODAY Musenne Aaroone, «Paaziga bonchchiza wogay hayssa; hara dere asi izappe oonikka mulera mooppo.
Intte miishshan shammida aylley oonikka intte iza qaxxaridaappe guye izappe maanaas koshshees.
Gido attiin guuththa wodes inttenara imaththateththan gam7izaynne une ooththiza hara dere asi izappe mooppo.
«Ha Paaziga yarshoza intte issi keeththan miite; intte he ashozappe aykkoka kare kessofte. Meqeththatappe issinokka menththofte.
Isra7eele maabaray wuri Paaziga yarsho bonchchanaas koshshees.

«Bete yiidi intte giddon diza asi GODAA Paaziga yarsho bonchchanaas koykko ba soon adde gidida asa ubbaa qaxxaro. Hessafe guye izi he biittan yelettida asa mala shiiqidi Paaziga yarsho bonchchanaas bessees. Gido attiin qaxxarettontta asi mulekka izappe mooppo.
Intte biittan yelettidayssaska gidiin intte giddon bete gididi dizayssaska gidiin hayssi wogay ubbaas issino» gides.
Histtiin Isra7eele asay wuri GODAY Musenne Aaroone azazida malakka ooththides.
He gallassankka GODAY Isra7eele nayta istta cugan cugan Gibxe biittafe kessides.

footnotes.text: Qore geetettizayssi issi issi bagga Gamoththo qaalan darmachcha, harason qasse margacha geetettees.
